defect_addressed.summary: A clean known no-change run settled NO_DIFF but its receipt had success false and the catalog verifier required PUBLISHED with a publication transaction, so completed prior requests failed re-verification and every new request ID was refused.
defect_addressed.source_lines_before: production_session_linux.go 598-608 and 627-628 (NO_DIFF), 672-673 (success requires PUBLISHED); production_workflow_catalog_linux.go 639-642 (verifier requires PUBLISHED)

change.production_session_linux.go: Adds noChangeReleased, set only in the no-change branch (bundle has no changes) when markNoPublication succeeds. Success is true for PUBLISHED with succeeded status, or for NO_DIFF with noChangeReleased. NO_DIFF from the Finalize zero-object path keeps success false.
change.production_workflow_catalog_linux.go: Adds productionReceiptSettlementClaimed: PUBLISHED needs succeeded status and a bounded transaction ID; NO_DIFF needs NO_DIFF status and an empty transaction ID. Adds verifyManagedPiNoPublicationSettlement, which accepts only an exact no-publication release for this admitted run, with no publication pending, transaction, or resolved record for the workflow, an admitted root identity equal to the current descriptor, and a ledger anchor. It returns no-publication plus the release record hash as the settlement ID. verifyCompletedServiceRequest uses the claim helper; verifyCompletedServiceRequestPins dispatches on disposition and uses the settlement ID in the terminal tuple.

not_verified: End-to-end verifyCompletedServiceRequest for a NO_DIFF receipt (protected root, LoadSettledCheckpoint, owner drain, Store journal TCB proof) is not exercised by a positive fixture.
A new request ID admitted after a verified NO_DIFF is not tested. The begin() gate is unchanged and its effect is not demonstrated.

The no-publication fixture writes the release record in the shape lease close() writes; it does not call close(), which needs a verified registration and authority. The fixture uses a file-backed audit journal in the same process, not a fresh-process reload.
The session Success expression is not directly tested; it needs full session composition.
Package-level unit and race runs were not verbose, so skips in pre-existing tests of cmd/tbound would not show. The changed and new tests were checked with -v and show zero skips.
open_objections: Unchanged-root evidence is identity-based: device, inode, mount, filesystem, uid, gid, and mode equal the admitted descriptor at verification, no publication record exists for the workflow, and the ledger anchor matches. No content or tree digest is recorded at the no-publication transition. A content proof would need a minimal addition at markNoPublication or close, reusing the tree-digest machinery that publication permits already use.

The Finalize zero-object path (publication status succeeded with no objects, disposition NO_DIFF) still has success false, so the verifier refuses it and new IDs stay blocked there. Its durable shape (pending, resolved succeeded, no transaction, release outcome publication-succeeded) is not accepted as no-change evidence. This needs an owner decision.

A callback known failure or denial that leaves a pending reservation still blocks settlement. validateSettledServiceDisposition is unchanged, so a valid NO_DIFF after such a denial cannot settle. This boundary is preserved, not weakened.

Receipt success for NO_DIFF means the settlement is verified no-change. The task outcome is still reported only through turn_completed and the existing receipt fields. A separate task-outcome field was not added. Confirm whether one is wanted.

The NO_DIFF settlement ID is no-publication plus the release record hash, stored in the terminal transaction slot. The catalog reload requires a bounded non-empty settlement ID on any terminal event that has a run link, so an empty value would break restart. Confirm this identity choice.
